name: Ops orchestrator
description: The coordinating layer. Connects events to the right specialist and keeps each case moving with context, evidence, and clear ownership.
label: persisted runs
detail: Assigns persisted specialist runs for release readiness, incident investigation, site onboarding, and platform health. Handoffs survive restarts. Consolidates results; never approves its own changes.

name: Incident & RCA
description: Connects symptoms, telemetry, and deployment changes to build an evidence-backed investigation.
label: persisted runs
detail: Correlates logs and metrics with change history. Keeps observed facts separate from hypotheses and creates a draft RCA for review.

name: Release & pipeline
description: Follows every release from preflight through verification, with a clear view of affected sites.
label: persisted runs
detail: Checks pipeline state, selects impacted sites, and collects test evidence. An approval brief is tied to the exact release revision.

name: Security & quality
description: Turns noisy findings into prioritized fixes and reviewable changes.
label: persisted runs
detail: Collects Snyk and Sonar findings and performs bounded AEM pattern review of configured files. Produces a remediation plan; source-code fixes require engineering validation.

name: Site factory
description: Builds a complete site proposal from approved templates, market requirements, and platform standards.
label: persisted runs
detail: Renders reviewed platform templates into one downloadable bundle and a provisioning plan. A separate exact-file approval can create a draft PR. AEM live-copy creation and publication remain external provisioning steps.

name: Content governance
description: Makes site health visible across accessibility, SEO, links, and inheritance.
label: persisted runs
detail: Combines configured page checks with AEM metadata from the supported bridge contract. Reports coverage and missing evidence, with approved inheritance exceptions.

name: Reporting & docs
description: Brings platform activity together into clear reports, release notes, and documentation.
label: persisted runs
detail: Builds reports from persisted run evidence. Markdown files can be exported or proposed as a documentation PR through the separate approval flow.
